project.name: ForwardMeasure Data Streaming Core
project.description: Backpressure pipeline primitives and execution-engine selection glue shared by the Pekko and Spark executors. Depends on the org's Reactive Streams SPI usage (Pekko Streams natively implements it; Camel connectors reach it via camel-reactive-streams) - see D6 in the design plan for why this is the seam between connectivity and execution rather than bespoke per-connector glue.
